select 'count' = 'default'

IF EXISTS (select 1 from metadata.tbl_Notification with (NOLOCK) where Jobid=@{pipeline().parameters.JobId}  and ado_IsEnabled=0)
select 'Count'= 'ado_disabled'
Else
IF Exists(SELECT * from logging.tbl_Notification_current 
where  JobId = @{pipeline().parameters.JobId}  and ado_WorkItemType='Alert')
select 'Count'='ado_enabled_task'
ELSE
select 'Count'='ado_enabled_alert'
